create_SE3_from_tensor: create an SE3 Lie group object from a 3x4 tensor representing rotation and translation
generate_random_SE3: generate a random SE3 transformation using SE3.rand for batched 6-DOF poses
transform_point_with_SE3: transform a 3D point using SE3.transform_from to apply rotation and translation
convert_SE3_to_quaternion: convert an SE3 transformation to x,y,z and w,x,y,z quaternion format using to_x_y_z_quaternion
compose_SE3_transformations: compose two SE3 transformations together using the compose method to chain poses
